answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed TypeScript types are out of date with the backend API. The generated output adds Scenario fields (scenario_safe_mode, scenario_asset_group_order, scenario_approval_status, etc.) that the PR did not commit. The step is deterministic, so a retry will fail the same way. Fix: run 'yarn generate-types-from-api' against the branch and commit the regenerated types.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
